en: Walk around town, talk to people, solve five tasks: shopping, delivery, quiz and a chat at the till.

en: Pictures flash, you write them down from memory — strictly, diacritics included. A hundred levels, three hearts.

en: The castellan is in hospital and every key is hidden. Twelve rooms, one key at a time, before the town council votes to sell the fortress.

en: Guests order in the accusative, you serve from pictures. Eight shifts, more items and adjectives each time.

en: You pick the stake. Push word crates into the garage of their category. Bigger stake, bigger warehouse.
es: Tú eliges la apuesta. Empuja las cajas de palabras al garaje de su categoría. Más apuesta, almacén más grande.

en: Fill the wagons before departure. The rule keeps changing: category, gender, first letter, translation.

en: Collect only the words of the given category. Intruders cost you hearts, ghosts chase you.

en: Eat letters in the right order to spell the word on the picture. A wrong letter costs a heart.

en: Two shores and a lighthouse. Jump into the cloud with the right word, climb to the portal and cross to the other side. Crabs climb too.
es: Dos orillas y un faro. Salta a la nube con la palabra correcta, sube hasta el portal y cruza al otro lado. Los cangrejos también trepan.

en: Twenty correct answers against the clock. Hits go to your mastered list, misses to the review list.
es: Veinte respuestas correctas contra el reloj. Los aciertos van a tu lista de dominadas y los fallos, a la lista de repaso.

en: Words fall towards your base, you click the translation. Fifteen waves, both directions, four answers along the bottom.
es: Las palabras caen hacia tu base y tú haces clic en la traducción. Quince oleadas, en ambas direcciones, con cuatro respuestas abajo.
